newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian army announces military exercises.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian army announces military exercises.

text.p: The Tanzanian People's Defence Forces has announced a week of military manoeuvres in Dar es Salaam and the coastal town of Bagamoyo north of the capital starting on Saturday, the Daily News reported.
The semi-official newspaper, quoting a statement from the inspector general of police, said 23 Tanzanian commanders and six Chinese military advisers would supervise the manoeuvres.
It did not give the number of soldiers involved but said uniformed soldiers would be unarmed during the "logistical military excercise".
